verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "The Lilies of the Covenant." A psalm of Asaph. Listen to us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You sit on your throne above the cherubim. Shine out
in front of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Wake up your power! Come and save us!
God, bring us back. Let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.
LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry with your people's prayers?
You have fed them with tears as their bread. You have made them drink bowls full of tears.
You have made us something our neighbours fight over. Our enemies laugh at us.
God of Armies, bring us back. Let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.
You brought a grapevine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations and planted it.
You cleared the ground for it. It put down deep roots and filled the land.
Its shade covered the mountains. Its branches were like mighty cedar trees.
It spread its branches out to the Mediterranean Sea and its shoots to the Euphrates River.
Why have you broken down its walls so that everyone who passes by picks its grapes?
Wild pigs from the forest ruin it. Wild animals from the fields feed on it.
God of Armies, please come back! Look down from heaven and see. Take care of this vine,
the root your right hand planted, the son you made strong for yourself.
It has been cut down and burned with fire. Your people are dying because of your angry warning.
Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you made strong for yourself.
Then we will not turn away from you. Give us new life, and we will call on your name.
LORD God of Armies, bring us back. Let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.
